articles.description:

articles.title: Nigerian Military Repels Terrorist Attack in Benue, Recovers Two AK-47 Rifles
articles.description: Rescues Two Kidnapping Victims along Naka–Ahume Road amid Persistent Violence By Ekani Olikita (MAKURDI) — Nigerian troops have repelled an armed attack in central Nigeria’s Benue State, recovering two AK-47 rifles and other items.
